snapshots.label: 1920 to 1945
snapshots.basis: Hand-scored from the historical record (programme and conduct in office). Scored on the 1920 programme and the 1933 to 1945 regime.

notes.ECO: Private ownership kept but subordinated to the state: price controls, four-year plan, unions abolished.
notes.SOC: Enforced traditional gender roles, persecuted homosexual men, instrumentalised the churches.
notes.LIB: Total surveillance and terror, no free speech, rule by decree after the Enabling Act.
notes.MIG: Racial ideology; persecution and genocide of Jews, Roma and others.
notes.INT: Left the League of Nations, autarky, wars of aggression.
notes.CLI: Climate not an issue; the 1935 nature protection law sat beside rearmament-first development.
notes.TEC: Not scored: issues did not exist in this form.
notes.DEM: Destroyed democracy: Führerprinzip, controlled courts, abolished the Länder's autonomy.
